result.reasoning: This commit ("bugfix: NPE in Util.retargetAnimation()") introduced the `if (sourceTrack != null)` guard that skips adding a track (and calling retargetTrack with a null-safe path) whenever a bone lacks a source track. While intended to prevent an NPE, this introduced the "retargeting logic error" being fixed in cd415ee4: skipping bones without a source track instead of retargeting them using the bind pose. The fix commit cd415ee4 removes this null check and instead makes retargetTrack itself handle a null sourceTrack by falling back to a single bind-pose keyframe — directly reversing the flawed logic introduced in e44a62e45505. The prior commit 5c9fe75bbbc1 (which added retargetTrack/retargetAnimation originally) did not have this skip-on-null behavior; it always called retargetTrack unconditionally, and would have simply NPE'd if sourceTrack was null. It was e44a62e45505 that added the incorrect skipping behavior corrected by the fix.
